info.title: api
info.description: v1 API binary per docs/v1/14. Old v0/tastile-api MUST NOT be imported here.

get.summary: List SourceTiles owned by the authenticated or queried owner.

post.summary: Create a new SourceTile.  Server owns all aggregate ids.

get.summary: Read one SourceTile plus its occurrences and placements.

put.summary:
Replace the SourceTile schedule, occurrence set, and revision.
Preserves historical occurrences/placement identity; advances
the SourceTile revision.

post.summary:
Cancel a SourceTile. Transitions the source from ACTIVE to
CANCELLED, emits a `v1_source_lifecycle_event` row, and closes
every source-managed (`source.kind = 4`) Placement whose span
overlaps the source's effective horizon. Running executions on
the closed placements finish naturally; new work cannot be
dispatched against them. Idempotent on retry.

get.summary: Derive per-segment and whole-occurrence completion for a SourceTile.
List canonical Placement rows for a SourceTile in owner scope.

post.summary:
Re-evaluate the SourceTile within a window.  Closes affected
auto-managed future placements and emits replacements without
touching detached / execution / placement-override rows.

422.description: Detached / execution / override protects a placement

get.summary:
List tiles (v1 view-model projection).  Per
docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-07-v1-tile-list-view-model.md Task 3
the handler projects `domain::TileListView` so every Tile parameter is
reachable through the API surface (v1/14 §9).

parameters.name: owner_ids
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of owner_ids.  Defaults to the authenticated
owner (= Personal scope) when omitted.

parameters.name: view_mode
parameters.description:
View bucketing.  `"by_state"` groups tiles by lifecycle.
Defaults to `"flat"` (no bucketing) for backwards compat with the
existing TileSummary-only consumers.

parameters.name: lifecycle
parameters.description:
Optional lifecycle filter.  One of "ready" | "started" | "done" |
"closed"; maps to `TileLifecycleKind` numeric constants via
`parse_view_filters`.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description:
Range string for `by_state` projection (e.g. "7d", "30d").  Only
used when `view_mode = "by_state"`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search across title / description / labels.

parameters.name: exclude_future
parameters.description:
When true, exclude tiles whose first upcoming placement is
strictly after the current instant.

offset_min.description:
Fixed offset override; omitted/null inherits the owner timezone.
Zero explicitly selects UTC.

reason.description:
Numeric cancel reason. See `domain::source_tile::state::cancel_reason`
for the registry values.

oneOf.description: Exactly two targets on the serde wire.

Between.description: Exactly two targets on the serde wire.

target_plan_id.description: Optional per-step Plan target; omitted steps inherit the output proposal Plan.

change_layer.description: Optional for legacy clients; omitted values default to Placement (1).

date_range_end.description: Exclusive ISO-8601 calendar date upper bound.

date_range_start.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 calendar date lower bound.

excluded_dates.description: ISO-8601 calendar dates skipped by this source. Omitted defaults to no exclusions.

offset_min.description:
Explicit local calendar offset in minutes east of UTC (e.g. 540
for Asia/Tokyo).  Omitted means the owner profile timezone
applies; both absent means UTC.

weekday_mask.description: Bitmask for Monday through Sunday; omitted means every weekday.

referenced_source_ref.description: May reference the operation-local source or a same-owner existing source.

subject_source_ref.description: Must be a local endpoint matching the source alias in this operation.

source_state.description: Numeric SourceTile lifecycle state (0 ACTIVE .. 3 CANCELLED).

SourceTileSummary.description: Mirror of `domain::read::SourceTileSummary` for utoipa schema generation.

TemporalView.description: Temporal window for a Tile (mirror of `domain::read::TemporalView`).
